name: Tatum White
strengths: White brings a true 6-5 / 290 frame with length to play over the ball as an interior/hybrid DL.
White already flashed disruptiveness as a freshman — TFLs and early production against varsity.
White has the mass-and-length mold to grow into an every-down interior presence if he keeps adding functional strength.
weaknesses: White is still early in the evaluation cycle — full Hudl package not on file for a verified Vault film desk watch yet.
comparison: White comps to Christian Barmore — 6-4/6-5 interior DL mold with length and early disruptive juice who grows into an every-down presence.
projection: White projects as a Year 2–3 SEC rotation DL (develop Year 1). Ceiling: every-down interior starter — the long Heard County 4-star who can two-gap and push the pocket.
schemeFit: White fits as a hybrid interior DL who can line over the guard/center and grow into run-and-pass disruptiveness.
insiderNotes: White is a 6-5 / 290 Heard County (Franklin, GA) 2029 DL. Florida offered Sept 1, 2026. Board already includes Georgia, FSU, Auburn, Tennessee, and Georgia Tech. Provisional Vault eval — no verified Hudl watch yet.
